team: DE ZERBI: “TO BECOME TOP TEAM WE NEED MANY THINGS!”  Tottenham
quote_text:
Good evening. Hi there, Roberto. Congratulations  on the win. It felt like a night where you  
needed goals and you got them. Obviously,  players like Solanke and Moore and Sávio,  
important for them all to score as well. Yes, we  need goals. We need to create chances to score. I  
think to become a top team, we need many things,  but one of these many things is to score, to be  
stronger. When we are attacking in the last 30  metres, we have to score, we have to shoot, we  
have to make combinations. We have a lot of very  good players and they have to make a big target,  
a big goal for them, to score and to increase  the number of goals. There will be competition  
in every position of the pitch and I will put on  the pitch the players with more goals, more able  
to create more chances to score. Yeah. You could  see how quickly the Tottenham fans took to Sávio  
as well. Was that the perfect introduction for  him? Yes, it's a perfect day for him. I think  
his biggest step, his biggest improvement,  is to increase the number of goals because,  
as qualities, I think he's one of the best  wingers. But the best wingers score many goals and  
I spoke with him yesterday, two days ago, and we  put the goal at 10, 12 goals because we need 10,  
12 goals from the wingers. Last season, I think we  suffered too much also because the number of goals  
was not enough to compete for nothing more than  that position. Just very quickly on Mikey Moore,  
how important is it for him as well to show  everyone what he can do? It's important for him.  
It's important for us because he's our player from  the academy. In these days, we have to understand  
what is the best solution for him, for us, because  I would like to keep him because he's young, but  
he's a good player. But we can't get the decision  wrong because anyway he needs to play. He needs  
to put games inside of him. And with Johan Lange  and Vinai, we have to find the best solution. Hi,  
Roberto. Can I just check on Micky van de Ven  and Kevin Danso after they both sort of hit their  
heads during the game? I think they are... They  were normal situations on the pitch, but nothing  
important. Good to hear. And then also, how did  it feel to finally have Mateus Fernandes start a  
competitive game for the club? Yeah, but Mateus  Fernandes is another talent, big talent. We are  
lucky because he can cover two positions on the  pitch, as a pivot or number 10. Anyway, he brings  
quality, he's dynamic and he fights on the pitch  because I think last season he was one of the  
best players in terms of recovering the ball, in  the duels. It's important, like Gallagher, because  
we can't forget Gallagher. I think today Rodrigo  Bentancur played very well. I think now he's very  
important for us. Unfortunately, he started the  season later than the other players, but when  
Rodrigo Bentancur is fit, is available, is in  the right physical condition, he's a different  
player because his understanding is great. He's  a different player. Did we see more of the real  
Tottenham tonight? A bit closer to what you want  the final version to be? I think we have to see  
the real Tottenham game by game and we have to be  consistent, consistent, consistent. We have to win  
games in a row: three, four, five, six. Yesterday,  like I said yesterday in the press conference,  
I think we have to change the mentality inside  of us. I spoke in the dressing room and our  
perspective has to change because we are working  well. We have good players. Even in the last two  
seasons, we lost many games and we finished in  17th position in the table. It doesn't matter  
for this season. This season is a new season.  It's a different atmosphere. I think, I hope,  
different players, different targets. I will  push every day to keep the humility, to keep  
the eyes on the ball and not on other things.  But anyway, we can't come to the training ground  
without ambition. I want players ambitious to win  many games in a row, to build the new mentality,  
to build a different mentality. And then I don't  know where we arrive, what we are able to achieve.  
We will see. But at the end, without the right  mentality, we can't achieve nothing for sure.  
May I ask about Sandro Tonali? Anything to be  concerned about, or just not risk him? Sandro was  
in a plan to work with Marcos Senesi yesterday,  very strong, to improve the physical condition.  
Sandro has to work to feel better in terms of  physical condition, but Saturday he will play  
in the first 11 without problems. When you look  at the game tonight, which is the improvement  
you're most proud of, considering you want this  team to improve? The order on the pitch. But  
there are two different games compared to the  game at Brentford. Different game. Man-to-man,  
all duels on the pitch in Brentford. Today  we controlled the game. We stayed 80%, 90%  
of the game in their half of the pitch. We played  with order. We can improve in the last third of  
the pitch with combinations, with attacking the  space or one-to-one. For sure, we can be better  
in the finishing of the ball possession.  But anyway, we kept the pitch very well.  
We moved the ball quickly, like I want. We scored.  I'm sorry for the goal we conceded because,  
like I said, we have to change the habits. We have  to be hungry. The goal we conceded can happen, but  
we have to work to close our goal every game. But  they are two different games. Also in Brentford,  
we know very well how to play that type of game  because we are able to play man-to-man. We are  
able to play and to fight in the duels. We are  able to keep the ball better than we did. We have  
the solution to attack the space more times than  we did in Brentford. Two different games. Roberto,  
Tottenham have drawn Liverpool at Anfield in the  next round. Can I just get some instant reaction?  
Great. It's a great game. If we want to win  the competition, we want to win the games.  
And sometimes in this competition, it can  happen to play already at the beginning of  
the competition against big, big teams. It's  a great challenge for the players, for me,  
for our club, and we have to arrive at that game  ready to play in our style, ready to play with  
personality, ready to play a game following  the work we are doing on the training ground.
title: DE ZERBI: “TO BECOME TOP TEAM WE NEED MANY THINGS!”  Tottenham 5-1 Charlton  Carabao Cup
